title: Hitler and Liberty Biberty: how?
description: Seven real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Liberty Biberty, through a former king, the Queen, a president, two TV actors and a talk-show host.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Liberty Biberty?
fun_fact: Liberty Biberty is named after a flub: in a 2019 Liberty Mutual ad, Tanner Novlan's struggling-actor character mangled the company's name into 'Liberty Biberty', and in 2026 the company turned the mistake into a puppet built by Jim Henson's Creature Shop.
research_note: Tanner Novlan had no free photo with anyone famous, so the route runs through a CBS group shot from The Talk with Jerry O'Connell, then O'Connell's We Are Men co-star Kal Penn, who once worked in Obama's White House.

image.file: File:Duc et duchesse de Windsor avec Hitler (1937).jpg

links.line: In 1937, Hitler welcomed Britain's ex-king, Edward VIII, to his mountain home.

image.file: File:Duke and Duchess of Gloucester wedding.png

links.line: Back in 1935, Edward joined his niece, Princess Elizabeth, at a royal wedding.

image.file: File:Barack Obama Michelle Obama Queen Elizabeth II Buckingham Palace London.jpg

links.line: In 2009, Queen Elizabeth welcomed Barack Obama to Buckingham Palace.
In 2011, Obama strolled the White House with his aide, actor Kal Penn.

image.file: File:The cast of We Are Men 2013.jpg

links.line: In 2013, Penn starred with Jerry O'Connell in the sitcom We Are Men.
In 2023, O'Connell welcomed Tanner Novlan, the insurance-ad actor, on The Talk.
And in 2026, Novlan's old flubbed line came to life as Liberty Biberty.
